text: Communication engineering is an interdisciplinary field that studies information transmission, switching, processing, and the design of communication systems. It covers the entire chain of technologies from basic signal processing to complex network architectures, aiming to achieve efficient and reliable transmission of information such as voice, data, and images. As the "neural network" of the information society, its technology is widely applied in 5G/6G communication, satellite communication, Internet of Things, artificial intelligence and other fields, and it is the core support for promoting digital and intelligent development.
